set.body: Studio blocker (eyes4s-7e, 2026-09-25). An analysis window is a sub-rectangle of the admission frame (e.g. a 1024x768 image on a 1920x1080 screen) with a named off-window policy (exclude from map, count, report). Today FixationCsv rejects out-of-frame positions and quarantines the whole trial, and the grid must live on the measure's frame or FrameMismatch. Sigma in degrees needs px/deg as a recorded plan parameter, not an app-side rescale. Per-trial/per-participant corrections (e.g. y-flip) are recorded in the admission ledger; the host never rewrites coordinates before hashing. Report per trial: outside window k of n fixations and % of duration.
set.title: UI-A: analysis window, px-per-degree and recorded frame corrections
